title: Channel appropriateness

questions.text: Should this action happen over email, Slack/internal workflow, CRM update, meeting, or not externally at all?

inputs: who the content is for (customer or internal)
what the customer asked to receive and how

criteria.text: customer-facing content uses a customer channel; internal content stays internal
criteria.guide: Internal-only channels (our Slack, CRM notes) never carry customer-facing content and vice versa.

criteria.text: the channel delivers what the customer asked for in the form they asked
criteria.guide: A call does not replace documents the customer asked to read; a note does not replace a reply.

failure_examples: A rep-internal concern should create an internal task rather than an external buyer email.
